## What it is

The ring, the four bars, and the cap, in place, with the tube. Not exported as its own STL.

## Design notes

- 14 openings. 72.90 mm of the 965.2 mm tube is straight. The helix is 892.30 mm, exactly 3.25 turns, so it starts in the first opening and the cut end is the centre of the last. One turn at 43.5 mm is 274.55 mm.
- Blue 1 has four, including the lowest. Yellow 2 has four, including the highest. Green 3 has three. Orange 4 has three.
- The mouths face outward. The cap can be on. Each bar plugs straight into a plain slot.
- The ring's centre hole is Ø44.8 mm. The cap's is Ø65.2 mm. The cap is 4.5 mm thick.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't mix these towers with the necked set. Those bores are in a different place.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: openings cut into the bar. No necks. Ring and cap unchanged.
